1
Daniel ne ne mfɛfoɔ wɔ Babel
1 # 2 Ah 24.1-2 Yudahene Yehoiakim afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, Babelhene Nebukadnessar baa Yerusalem, na ɔbɛto hyɛɛ wɔn so. 2Na AWURADE de Yudahene Yehoiakim ne Nyankopɔn fie nnoɔma no bi hyɛɛ ne nsa, na ɔsoa de kɔɔ n’anyame fie wɔ Sinar asase so; na ɔde nnwinneɛ no kɔɔ ne nyame adekoradan mu. 3#2 Ah 20.18 Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ n’apiafoɔhene Aspenas, sɛ ɔmfa Israel mu, ahemfo asefoɔ ne mmapɔmma no mu, 4mmerantewaa a wɔn ho nni dɛm na wɔn ho yɛ fɛ, na wɔn ani ateɛ, nyansa nyinaa mu, na wɔnim de na wɔwɔ nhunumu, na wɔbɛtumi asom wɔ ɔhene ahemfie, na ɔnkyerɛ wɔn mma wɔnsua Kaldeafoɔ nwoma ne kasa. 5Na ɔhene yii wɔn ahennuane no bi, da biara ne ne deɛ, ne nsa a ɔnom no bi, sɛ wɔntete wɔn mfeɛ mmiɛnsa; na ɛno akyi wɔmmɛsom ɔhene. 6Na wɔn mu bi a wɔfiri Yudafoɔ mu ne Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria; 7na asomfoɔ panin no totoo wɔn din. Ɔtoo Daniel din sɛ Beltesasar, na ɔtoo Hanania din sɛ Sadrak, na ɔtoo Misael din sɛ Mesak, na ɔtoo Asaria din sɛ Abed-Nego.
8 # Lew 11 Na Daniel bɔɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔremfa ɔhene nnuane ne nsa a ɔnom no ngu ne ho fi, enti ɔsrɛɛ apiafohene no, na wangu ne ho fi. 9#Gye 39.21 Na Onyankopɔn maa Daniel nyaa asomfoɔ panin no anim adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu. 10Na asomfoɔ panin no ka kyerɛɛ Daniel sɛ: Mesuro, ɛfiri sɛ anyɛ a, me wura ɔhene a wayi mo aduane ne mo anonneɛ no bɛhunu mo anim sɛ ɛyɛ mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ sene mo atipɛnfoɔ mmerantewaa no deɛ, na moama me tiri ato, ɔhene anim. 11Ɛnna Daniel ka kyerɛɛ ɔsomfoɔ a asomfoɔ panin no de no asi Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria soɔ no sɛ: 12Sɔ wo nkoa hwɛ dadu ɛ, na wɔmma yɛn afuomduane nni ne nsuo nnom, 13na wode w’ani ahwɛ yɛn ne mmerantewaa a wɔdi ahennuane no anim, na sɛdeɛ wobɛhunu no, wo ne wo nkoa adi. 14Ɛnna ɔpenee deɛ wɔkaeɛ no soɔ, na ɔsɔɔ wɔn hwɛɛ dadu. 15Na dadu no wiee duro no, wɔhunuu wɔn anim sɛ ɛyɛ fɛ na wɔn honam aba wɔn ho sene mmerantewaa a wɔdi ahennuane no nyinaa. 16Ɛnna ɔsomfoɔ no yii wɔn aduane pa ne nsa a wɔbɛnom no, na ɔmaa wɔn afuomduane.
17 # Hes 28.3 Na mmerantewaa baanan yi, Onyankopɔn maa wɔn nwoma ne nyansa nyinaa mu nimdeɛ ne aniteɛ, na Daniel nyaa anisoadehunu ne daeɛ nyinaa mu nhunumu. 18Na berɛ a ɔhene kaa sɛ wɔmfa wɔn mmra no duruiɛ no, asomfoɔ panin no de wɔn baa Nebukadnessar anim. 19Na ɔhene ne wɔn kasae, na wɔanhunu wɔn nyinaa mu deɛ ɔte sɛ Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria; na wɔde wɔn kaa ɔhene apamfoɔ no ho. 20Na nyansa ne nhunumu asɛm biara a ɔhene bisaa wɔn no, ɔhunuu wɔn sɛ wɔkyɛne nkonyaayifoɔ ne pɛadeahunufoɔ a wɔwɔ n’ahennie mu no nyinaa mprɛdu. 21#Esra 1.1 Na Daniel tenaa hɔ kɔduruu Ɔhene Kores afe a ɛdi kan so.

Yudahene Yehoiakim afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, Babelhene Nebukadnessar baa Yerusalem, na ɔbɛto hyɛɛ wɔn so. Na AWURADE de Yudahene Yehoiakim ne Nyankopɔn fie nnoɔma no bi hyɛɛ ne nsa, na ɔsoa de kɔɔ n’anyame fie wɔ Sinar asase so; na ɔde nnwinneɛ no kɔɔ ne nyame adekoradan mu. Na ɔhene ka kyerɛɛ n’apiafoɔhene Aspenas, sɛ ɔmfa Israel mu, ahemfo asefoɔ ne mmapɔmma no mu, mmerantewaa a wɔn ho nni dɛm na wɔn ho yɛ fɛ, na wɔn ani ateɛ, nyansa nyinaa mu, na wɔnim de na wɔwɔ nhunumu, na wɔbɛtumi asom wɔ ɔhene ahemfie, na ɔnkyerɛ wɔn mma wɔnsua Kaldeafoɔ nwoma ne kasa. Na ɔhene yii wɔn ahennuane no bi, da biara ne ne deɛ, ne nsa a ɔnom no bi, sɛ wɔntete wɔn mfeɛ mmiɛnsa; na ɛno akyi wɔmmɛsom ɔhene. Na wɔn mu bi a wɔfiri Yudafoɔ mu ne Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria; na asomfoɔ panin no totoo wɔn din. Ɔtoo Daniel din sɛ Beltesasar, na ɔtoo Hanania din sɛ Sadrak, na ɔtoo Misael din sɛ Mesak, na ɔtoo Asaria din sɛ Abed-Nego.
Na Daniel bɔɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔremfa ɔhene nnuane ne nsa a ɔnom no ngu ne ho fi, enti ɔsrɛɛ apiafohene no, na wangu ne ho fi. Na Onyankopɔn maa Daniel nyaa asomfoɔ panin no anim adɔeɛ ne mmɔborɔhunu. Na asomfoɔ panin no ka kyerɛɛ Daniel sɛ: Mesuro, ɛfiri sɛ anyɛ a, me wura ɔhene a wayi mo aduane ne mo anonneɛ no bɛhunu mo anim sɛ ɛyɛ mmɔbɔmmɔbɔ sene mo atipɛnfoɔ mmerantewaa no deɛ, na moama me tiri ato, ɔhene anim. Ɛnna Daniel ka kyerɛɛ ɔsomfoɔ a asomfoɔ panin no de no asi Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria soɔ no sɛ: Sɔ wo nkoa hwɛ dadu ɛ, na wɔmma yɛn afuomduane nni ne nsuo nnom, na wode w’ani ahwɛ yɛn ne mmerantewaa a wɔdi ahennuane no anim, na sɛdeɛ wobɛhunu no, wo ne wo nkoa adi. Ɛnna ɔpenee deɛ wɔkaeɛ no soɔ, na ɔsɔɔ wɔn hwɛɛ dadu. Na dadu no wiee duro no, wɔhunuu wɔn anim sɛ ɛyɛ fɛ na wɔn honam aba wɔn ho sene mmerantewaa a wɔdi ahennuane no nyinaa. Ɛnna ɔsomfoɔ no yii wɔn aduane pa ne nsa a wɔbɛnom no, na ɔmaa wɔn afuomduane.
Na mmerantewaa baanan yi, Onyankopɔn maa wɔn nwoma ne nyansa nyinaa mu nimdeɛ ne aniteɛ, na Daniel nyaa anisoadehunu ne daeɛ nyinaa mu nhunumu. Na berɛ a ɔhene kaa sɛ wɔmfa wɔn mmra no duruiɛ no, asomfoɔ panin no de wɔn baa Nebukadnessar anim. Na ɔhene ne wɔn kasae, na wɔanhunu wɔn nyinaa mu deɛ ɔte sɛ Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria; na wɔde wɔn kaa ɔhene apamfoɔ no ho. Na nyansa ne nhunumu asɛm biara a ɔhene bisaa wɔn no, ɔhunuu wɔn sɛ wɔkyɛne nkonyaayifoɔ ne pɛadeahunufoɔ a wɔwɔ n’ahennie mu no nyinaa mprɛdu. app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
